choices.content: The probability has already become the next value of the relative frequency
The probability can be estimated as \(1/5\)
The event will definitely occur on the next trial
The trials can stop, and the result will no longer change

question.prompt: What does a relative frequency stabilizing around \(1/5\) indicate?

solutions.explanation: Relative frequency provides an estimate. The next trial is still random.
solutions.title: Interpret frequency stabilization
